changes.why: The across field should name the variables compared (family members, successive tests), not the referent itself. DOHMH's intervention level is a second fixed referent the text applies.

equity.level_reason: Immigrant origin (nativity) appears only as a descriptor of surma users and of the family; no results are reported by a social-position dimension and no disparity is framed.

level_alternative.reason: Immigrant origin could be read as only defining the population of a single-family case series, which is level 0.
